response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong senior individual contributor with relevant hands-on experience in backend systems and some exposure to fintech and AI agent tooling. However, this is an executive CTO role requiring a proven track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+, developing senior leaders, and operating at a strategic level. His resume shows no experience in people management, team scaling, or executive leadership, making him a fundamental mismatch for the seniority and core responsibilities of the position.
strengths: Deep expertise in backend and distributed systems, including microservices and high-throughput environments.
Direct experience in the fintech sector (RIDE Capital) and with pricing optimization.
Recent hands-on work contributing to AI-agent infrastructure and tooling.
concerns: Complete lack of formal engineering leadership or people management experience.
No demonstrated history of scaling an engineering team, a core requirement of the role.
Experience is exclusively as a senior individual contributor, not an executive leader.
